drivingQuestion: May one depart from a rule one has taught, and may a groom take the stringency of reciting Shema upon himself?
outcomeNote: Mishna material: two incidents with Rabban Gamliel's replies, and an unresolved tannaitic dispute about the groom who wishes to recite.

segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ רָחַץ לַיְלָה הָרִאשׁוֹן שֶׁמֵּתָה אִשְׁתּוֹ. אָמְרוּ לוֹ תַּלְמִידָיו: לִמַּדְתָּנוּ רַבֵּינוּ שֶׁאָבֵל אָסוּר לִרְחוֹץ? אָמַר לָהֶם אֵינִי כִּשְׁאָר בְּנֵי אָדָם, אִסְטְנִיס אֲנִי.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» The mishna relates another episode portraying unusual conduct by Rabban Gamliel. «He bathed on the first night after his wife died. His students said to him:» Have «you» not «taught us, our teacher, that a mourner is prohibited to bathe?» He answered them: «I am not like other people, I am delicate [istenis].» For me, not bathing causes actual physical distress, and even a mourner need not suffer physical distress as part of his mourning.

segments.he: וּכְשֶׁמֵּת טָבִי עַבְדּוֹ קִבֵּל עָלָיו תַּנְחוּמִין. אָמְרוּ לוֹ תַּלְמִידָיו: לִמַּדְתָּנוּ רַבֵּינוּ שֶׁאֵין מְקַבְּלִין תַּנְחוּמִין עַל הָעֲבָדִים? אָמַר לָהֶם: אֵין טָבִי עַבְדִּי כִּשְׁאָר כָּל הָעֲבָדִים, כָּשֵׁר הָיָה.
segments.en: Another exceptional incident is related: «And when his slave, Tavi, died,» Rabban Gamliel «accepted condolences for his» death as one would for a close family member. «His students said to him: Have you» not «taught us, our teacher, that one does not accept condolences for» the death of «slaves?» Rabban Gamliel said to his students: «My slave, Tavi, is not like all the rest of the slaves, he was virtuous» and it is appropriate to accord him the same respect accorded to a family member.

segments.he: חָתָן אִם רוֹצֶה לִקְרוֹת קְרִיאַת שְׁמַע לַיְלָה הָרִאשׁוֹן — קוֹרֵא, רַבָּן שִׁמְעוֹן בֶּן גַּמְלִיאֵל אוֹמֵר: לֹא כָּל הָרוֹצֶה לִיטּוֹל אֶת הַשֵּׁם, יִטּוֹל.
segments.en: With regard to the recitation of Shema on one’s wedding night, the Sages said that «if,» despite his exemption, «a groom wishes to recite Shema on the first night,» he may do so. «Rabban Shimon ben Gamliel says: Not everyone who wishes to assume the reputation» of a God-fearing person «may assume» it, and consequently, not everyone who wishes to recite Shema on his wedding night may do so.

moves.summary: Rabban Gamliel — the unnamed subject, carried from the mishna at berakhot.16a.8 — bathed on the first night of mourning
moves.about: Rabban Gamliel bathed on the first night after his wife died, though a mourner may not bathe

moves.cueHe: אמרו לו תלמידיו: למדתנו רבינו שאבל אסור לרחוץ
moves.summary: his students press him with the rule he taught them
moves.about: whether Rabban Gamliel may bathe in mourning when he himself taught that a mourner is forbidden to bathe

moves.cueHe: אמר להם: איני כשאר בני אדם
moves.summary: he is delicate, and a mourner need not suffer physical distress
moves.about: he is delicate, so abstaining from bathing would cause him real physical distress

moves.cueHe: וכשמת טבי עבדו קבל עליו תנחומין
moves.summary: he accepted condolences when his slave Tavi died
moves.about: Rabban Gamliel accepted condolences on the death of his slave Tavi

moves.cueHe: אמרו לו תלמידיו: למדתנו רבינו שאין מקבלין תנחומין על העבדים
moves.summary: again they press him with his own ruling
moves.about: whether he may accept condolences for a slave when he himself taught that one does not

moves.cueHe: אמר להם: אין טבי עבדי כשאר כל העבדים
moves.summary: Tavi was virtuous and not like other slaves
moves.about: Tavi was not like other slaves, and so is not covered by the rule

moves.cueHe: חתן אם רוצה לקרות קריאת שמע לילה הראשון — קורא
moves.summary: a groom who wishes to recite Shema on the first night may do so
moves.about: whether a groom who wishes to recite Shema on his wedding night may do so

moves.cueHe: רבן שמעון בן גמליאל אומר: לא כל הרוצה ליטול את השם, יטול
moves.summary: not everyone who wishes to take the name of piety may take it
